verdict.rationale: Cekura documents its own SDK-based tracing for LiveKit agents. It also documents ingesting call logs (transcript, recording URL, metadata) and a pre-defined latency metric. However, nothing shows per-LLM-call traces capturing prompt inputs and outputs, latency, or token usage. Missing for 10: per-LLM-call span capture, explicit input/output recording at the LLM-call level, token usage tracking, framework-agnostic instrumentation beyond LiveKit, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture traces of my LLM calls with inputs, outputs, latency, and token usage

citations.quote: Enhanced observability for LiveKit agents using the Cekura SDK
Enable deep observability for LiveKit agents with SDK integration

Your agent (or its provider's post-call webhook) POSTs here with the transcript, recording URL, and metadata; Cekura stores it as a `CallLog`, schedules metric evaluation, and surfaces it in Observability.
Pre-defined Metrics: These are generic metrics such as CSAT, pitch, latency, and interruption count.
